name: SuperMini nRF52840 (nice!nano clone)
description: $5 clone of the nice!nano v2: nRF52840 with USB-C, LiPo charging on BAT pads and the Adafruit UF2 bootloader in a Pro Micro-compatible layout; cheapest BLE 5 board with 1 MB flash.
notes: Clone of the nice!nano v2 layout (Pro Micro-compatible pinout); no vendor page: the nice!nano page is the reference design. Dimensions, LED and charger details vary by seller, and some 'SuperMini nRF52840' listings are a smaller ~22 mm board: check the listing.
Adafruit nRF52 UF2 bootloader: double-tap reset to mount as a drive. Works with ZMK, Arduino (Adafruit nRF52 core) and Zephyr.
Battery pads (BAT+/BAT-) with an on-board charger; some clones omit the VCC switch (P0.13) or the battery-voltage divider (P0.04) that nice!nano has.
Size, GPIO count and price are estimates for the Pro Micro form factor.
